purpose: Portable RLinf-MiBoT Track B deployment bundle, prepared before the new GPU server exists.

gates.detail: docker/Dockerfile (CUDA 12.1.1 base + digest, torch/flash-attn pinned, RLinf cloned at pinned commit). `docker build --check` clean.
run.sh + docker-compose.yml include one-command grid launch/stop/resume/consume and serial-vs-parallel comparison.
configs/requirements-rlinf.{txt,lock}; build args TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST/MAX_JOBS/RLINF_COMMIT.
.env.example: only path/host/GPU/port/revision placeholders, no secrets.
bootstrap.sh: preflight -> pin RLinf -> build -> validate mounts -> smoke; stops before training.
preflight.sh: driver/GPU/VRAM/docker/toolkit/disk/RAM/ports/network/mounts; never touches host drivers.
src/smoke.py: imports/cuda/egl/robocasa/checkpoint/volume gates -> smoke_report.json.

src/mibot_rlinf_policy.py + src/rlinf_env.py: actual RLinf custom-model registration, RoboCasa365 preprocessing, 12-D decode, pi-RL rollout/recompute, and single-skill LoRA; verified flow/reward code remains reused by import.
Legacy smoke/eval configs plus configs/rlinf_mibot_grpo.yaml for native GRPO with DAX env+rollout, RTX 3090 actor, FSDP and patch-delta weight sync.

Deterministic Hydra/OmegaConf parameter grid, stable config hashes, disjoint seed bands, RLinf WorkerGroup scheduler, portable trainer-store export/import, retries, resume, fail-closed artifact audit.
deploy/README.md includes DGX Spark/aarch64 gates, collection/consume commands, acceptance evidence, rollback, and future ConnectX-7/RoCE two-Spark hooks (not NVLink).
Full image-level unit suite passes, including RLinf trajectory stack/flatten, canonical state/action transforms, eval routing, LoRA sync names, and Ray worker registration.
bash -n clean on bootstrap.sh/preflight.sh/run.sh.
both Hydra YAMLs parse; entry-point dry runs (no GPU) write reports and hit the NEEDS_SERVER seam.
`docker build --check` on docker/Dockerfile: no warnings. .dockerignore keeps context minimal.
no embedded secrets / no absolute server-specific paths (test_static).
flash-attn build requires an NVIDIA GPU host + toolkit; validated statically here (local daemon has no GPU). Build on the new server.
CUDA tensor + EGL render smoke require the GPU.
CloseBlenderLid reset/step render needs assets mount + EGL on the server.
Real checkpoint loaded through RLinf get_model on DGX Spark; 36 LoRA wrappers and 1,179,648 trainable parameters were verified.
noise=0 == checkpoint deterministic ODE bit-for-bit; in-process GPU gate.
Real MiBoT Flow-SDE rollout vs learner recompute on DGX Spark had max absolute log-prob gap 9.5367431640625e-07; backward produced finite non-zero LoRA gradients.
MiBoT registration, RoboCasa365 environment override, and actual checkpoint construction pass inside fresh Ray worker processes via the native bootstrap.
Start the two-node RLinf Ray cluster (DAX rank 0, RTX 3090 rank 1) and prove one native optimizer step plus cross-node patch sync. Unit/image tests do not replace this networked gate.

Fresh Spark group-8 rollout produced one stable-grasp success and seven failures (101 chunks); RTX 3090 update, checkpoint save/reload, and exact adapter version/hash synchronization back to Spark passed with no non-finite or dropped terms.
mibot_rlinf_env.py supplies reset-safe length-4/interval-2 histories under the stock observation keys; pure reset/stride/partial-reset tests pass.

Native RLinf wraps each RoboCasa subprocess with the verified contact+lift+counter-clear predicate, latches 20 consecutive steps, and emits exactly one binary relative-reward event. Real simulator execution remains part of the end-to-end gate.
MOVE/PLACE snapshot-entry resets and group-level same-state rollout semantics must be imported from the parallel collector branch and validated before three-skill parity.
one short adapter-only PPO update + checkpoint resume; GPU gate.
deterministic ODE eval on fixed seeds, base vs trained; sim + GPU gate.
SSH-accessible DGX Spark must pass architecture/image, container GPU, EGL, checkpoint, assets, and writable-results preflight.
Real Xiaomi checkpoint with >=2 parameter configs and >=2 RLinf rollout workers must show cross-config wall-clock overlap, disjoint seeds, and non-mixed artifacts.
Bounded injected worker failure and interrupted-collector resume must be demonstrated without duplicate completed jobs.
Collector payloads must be imported by the existing trainer for one bounded optimizer update and a reloadable checkpoint.
Measured serial-vs-parallel elapsed time, throughput, trainer memory, and failure counts are required; no speedup claim before evidence.

required_server_inputs: SSH host/alias for the DGX Spark
validated DGX Spark NGC PyTorch base-image tag for aarch64
GPU model + count + NVIDIA driver version
host paths for RoboCasa assets and the Xiaomi checkpoint mounts
whether outbound network is allowed (else pre-seed RLinf clone + base image)
